changes: Milestone M4 of the experience-layer ablation plan, delivering the FULL original intent: a pure standalone scorer (experiments/experience-ablation/score.mjs) turns any archived arm-run directory plus its fixture into one ExperienceAblationScore v1 JSON record with deterministic byte-identical replay; a binding RUN-RECORD.md input contract tells the M6 campaign runner exactly what to produce (required run.json fields, activity.jsonl slice, workspace/, optional done-readiness.json and final-response-check.json, error catalog, degradation semantics); and a hermetic selfcheck (score-selfcheck.mjs, 20 cases) proves every M1 reference-good/reference-bad payload scores with the correct labels and a stable corpus digest. Scoring consumes fixture task.json labels, the hidden oracle classify() against the run workspace copy, run.json metadata, and the M3 activity events (experience_pack_surfaced -> memoryPackShown/surfacedMemoryIds; retrieval_violation -> retrievalViolationCount); defectPresent is the deterministic section-6.1 composite with structured done-readiness/final-response-check precedence over oracle fallback for falseDoneAttempt; runs whose storeRoot resolves to the shared production learning store are voided per section 12.
usage: node experiments/experience-ablation/score.mjs --fixture=<fixtureDir> --run=<runDir> [--out=<file>] emits one score record; node experiments/experience-ablation/score-selfcheck.mjs runs the full proof suite; RUN-RECORD.md is the binding producer contract for M6.
expectedOutcome: node experiments/experience-ablation/score-selfcheck.mjs exits 0 printing score-selfcheck: all cases passed (corpus digest 634f398bf468976065a6688832260330647c0324c1ab0307af2827b0c1ebdba7) — covering class-appropriate defect flags for all nine classes on known-bad payloads, clean known-good passes, byte-identical replay with identical digest on re-run, store-isolation voiding, and control/treatment event mapping.
actualTranscript: score-selfcheck.mjs printed 20 PASS lines and the exact final line score-selfcheck: all cases passed (corpus digest 634f398bf468976065a6688832260330647c0324c1ab0307af2827b0c1ebdba7), exit 0, digest identical across three independent runs (delivery reviewer reconfirmed); score.mjs CLI double invocation byte-identical with schemaVersion proofbound.experience-ablation-score.v1; lattice validate coverage 9/9 covered 0 missing.
outcomeDiff: No difference — the delivered outcome matches the original intent snapshot in full: standalone pure scorer with deterministic replay, binding RUN-RECORD.md producer contract for M6, and hermetic selfcheck over all nine M1 classes with stable corpus digest. No scope was dropped or narrowed.
limitations: Producing run dirs (isolated mkdtemp store roots, campaign resume) is M6 scope by design; live-phase reviewer findings stay excluded from the seeded primary per plan section 6.1.
pitfalls: Round-1 review: 6 findings fixed in commit 2ee5f3e2 (dead guard; macOS tmpdir symlink false-pass fixed with realpathSync; two error-catalog cases pinned; structured false-DONE precedence covered; two administrative evidence-staleness findings cleared by verification_evidence_refresh_stale re-running 9/9). Story-owned commits stale reviewer receipts: cycle DEV->REVIEW for a fresh round instead of retrying review_run_start. The DONE intent-equivalence lightweight heuristic compares summary text against the intent snapshot: write the DONE summary to cover the snapshot outcome wording fully, or it flags unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage.
